File.name: 02-2K-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes, for once, I am. What's with those clothes?
I'm going to change right away. Oh, that's right. Where did you put our thermos?
Our vacuum bottle. We have one, right?
It's in the back of the cupboard, on the left. What are you going to use it for?
It looks like it's going to be a cold day tomorrow, so I thought I'd bring something warm to drink.
Onee-chan's been acting strange lately, reading books on sewing and digging up books on cooking and stuff.
I see. So, Kotonoha's finally going through that phase.
Kotonoha, I'm going to teach you my recipe for making lemonade. I'm sure your boyfriend is going to love it.
'B-boyfriend'...? I... it's not like that. I just...
Oh, don't worry. What's more, I've got some movie tickets from a client. Would you like them?

File.name: 02-2K-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Lemonade really is best drunk warm, isn't it?
It's delicious when it's cool, too, but it's a cold day today, so I thought it would be better to have it warm.
I see. It really does warm you up.
Ufufu... that's good to hear. Oh, that's right.
Would you like to go and see a movie? I've got some extra tickets.
A romance, huh. Oh? There's a whole heap of showtimes this week. All the way to Friday.
I guess that means we've got to go sometime this week... do you have the time? What about your student rep meetings?

File.name: 02-2K-B02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun... he didn't come after all...

File.name: 02-2K-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Do you truly believe that the conclave would permit such actions...?
Wait! You've got the wrong idea! Duke is...!

File.name: 02-2K-D00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It sure was. I expected it to be an average romance, but...
Yeah, and then it became a spy movie, and a horror movie...
They say it's a remake of an old movie, but there can't be much of the original left in there.
Probably not. Maybe I'll try borrowing the original sometime.
Ah, in that case, why don't we watch it together?
Okay, I'll be sure to have everything ready at my house.
We're going to watch it at your house?
Of course I do. It just makes me kind of nervous to be visiting a girl's house.
I'm looking forward to it, though.

File.name: 02-2K-D01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. It's in Motehara-sakashita, so it's the next stop.
I... I see. I feel kind of nervous.

File.name: 02-2K-E01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai! It's a nice day today, so let's eat outside!

File.name: 02-2K-E02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Got a minute? There's something I want to talk about.
Yamamoto will be here soon, you know.
Just for a second. Come on.

File.name: 02-2K-E03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Listen, you know that quiet-looking girl in class 4?
There was a really unpleasant atmosphere between her and Itou.
Maybe Itou tried to make a move on her, and now she hates him! How nasty!
They were both acting awkward, like they'd just been fighting or something. You could tell just by looking.

File.name: 02-2K-E04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are you having lunch with Katsura-san on the roof again today?
Yeah. You want to come too?
Are you and Katsura-san getting along?
Ahaha... I was worried that you might have tried to make a move on her and gotten on her bad side.
L... let's go outside for a minute.

File.name: 02-2K-E06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm going to do my best.

File.name: 02-2K-E10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What is it? Why are you staring at me?

File.name: 02-2K-F00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ehehe... I have some black tea today.
It's a souvenir from Mom's business trip to Shanghai.
What kind of black tea is it?
It's always just the two of us up here on the roof, isn't it?
Yeah. That's because this place is normally off-limits to students.
Well, yeah... but Sekai went and got permission.
Yeah. Sekai got permission to use the roof by saying that
she wanted to revive the old astronomy club and having her friends sign up as fake club members.
That's why if Sekai stops hanging around here, we should probably sign up as astronomy club members too.
No, I like the stars. It'd be nice if we could really stargaze instead of being astronomy club members in name only.
Well, I hear that with the club dissolved, there's no equipment anymore.
If you want to see the stars, though, there's a planetarium at Sakakino Hills.
It's getting a little cold, isn't it?

File.name: 02-2K-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: T... that's right. We'd better be heading back to class.

File.name: 02-2K-G01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... I just remembered something I have to do...
Well, I'll be going on ahead.

File.name: 02-2K-G02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Come on, let's pack up and head back to class.

File.name: 02-2K-G03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: C-come on, we'd better pack up.

File.name: 02-2K-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "From: Katsura Kotonoha\nSub: I'm sorry\nSorry about what happened earlier."

File.name: 02-2K-H02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "From: Itou Makoto\nSub: Re: I'm sorry\nI'd sure like to hold you again."

File.name: 02-2K-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "From: Itou Makoto\nSub: Re: I'm sorry\nDon't worry about it."

File.name: 02-2K-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai! Let's stop by Pure Burger on the way home.

File.name: 02-2K-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Huh? Makoto, weren't you going to see Katsura-san... ah.
I did exactly what you told me.
Looks to me like you tried to force her to do something against her will.
Haah... fine, I guess the least I could do is hear you out.

File.name: 02-2K-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought really hard about it, and I...
I think it's best if we give each other some space.
At this rate, I'll just end up hurting you by doing things you don't want me to do, and you...
That's... not true. With a little time, I'm sure we'd...
I thought it was a matter of time, too... but I think we need some room as well as time to really understand each other.
Let's not see each other for a while.

File.name: 02-2K-J00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah, all the schools along this line finish at the same time.
Don't you usually get on at this time?
No. On the days when I don't have student rep meetings, I spend a little time in the library and get on when there are fewer people.

File.name: 02-2K-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I wanted to go home with you.

File.name: 02-2K-J02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You should have done that today, too.

SetSELECT.sel2: 'If it's just for a little while...'

File.name: 02-2K-J04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I've got to get out of the way...
Nn... I... I guess it can't be helped... since it's so crowded.

SetSELECT.sel1: 'If it's just for a little while...'

File.name: 02-2K-J05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Just a little... should be okay.

File.name: 02-2K-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I shouldn't have done that today...

File.name: 02-2K-K04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's wrong? Why are you calling so late?
Ah, is now a bad time?
No, it's just that you usually send an e-mail.
Yeah, but... I kind of wanted to apologize.
I did some things today that you weren't comfortable with.

SetSELECT.sel2: 'That's why I'll stay away from you'

File.name: 02-2K-K05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Whenever I look at you, I feel all excited... like I can't stop myself from embracing you.
...Is this what it feels like to love someone?
That's a bad feeling. It's not the same as love.
I... like you, but... I don't feel the same way.

File.name: 02-2K-K06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: That's why I'll stay away from you.
It seems that all I can do is make you feel awful, so...
It's okay. I know it's hard for you to endure, too.
I'll endure it. I can do that.
I understand... so I can endure it.
So please, don't say that you'll stay away from me.
Because I want us to be together too.
That's okay. I should be the one apologizing to you.
You've got nothing to be sorry for.
Yes... but when I think about how I've made you suffer, it hurts.
In time, I'm sure we'll find the distance that's right for us and build a good relationship on that.
When you hugged me... I was a little nervous, and I kind of felt awful, but...
Yes... that's part of how I really feel, too... That's why I'd like a little more time.
Yes, you're right. Let's take things one step at a time.
Yes, one step at a time...
I'm glad I was able to speak to you, too. Good night.

File.name: 02-2K-L01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Boys... want to touch, don't they...?
Ooh... sheesh! This is so embarrassing...

File.name: 02-2K-L02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: This is no good... I'm making Makoto-kun feel bad again.
I don't want to be touched... but I promised to consider his feelings.
...At least, that's what I wanted to do.

File.name: 02-2K-L03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes... that's right... he wants to touch me, doesn't he...?

File.name: 02-2K-M04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I-I'm sorry, I didn't mean to...

File.name: 02-2K-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You know, I overslept a little today, so that's why I'm late...
Well, you know, I got onto a different train than the one I usually take, and I saw Itou.
It felt like there was something going on between Itou and that girl from the other class.
You know, that quiet-looking girl from class 4.
He and that girl, well, they were looking really awkward.
Maybe Itou tried to make a move on her, and now she hates him! How nasty!
They were both acting awkward, like they'd just been fighting or something. You could tell just by looking.
Your boyfriend's getting up to something funny behind your back. You ought to just break up with him.
I told you, he's not my...
Hurry up and take your seats.

File.name: 02-2K-N01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I want to talk to you about something.
Eh? But I've got a student rep meeting today...

File.name: 02-2K-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you like, you can tell me about it... ah, and if you don't think I can help, I can go and find someone who can!
It's weird... whenever I think about her, I feel like I want to embrace her and...
and even do those perverted things you keep talking about.
Just yesterday, I couldn't help myself. I forced myself on her, and...
But... it's normal to want to do those things with the person you love, right?
You probably just went about it the wrong way.
Anyone would be afraid if you just suddenly threw yourself at them.
I... guess I was a little forceful.
I just don't know how to take a girl's feelings into consideration like that...
You're technically a girl, right? You should know.
'Technically'... that's just mean. Well, I guess you'd normally kiss her...
Listen, why don't you practice on me?
It'll just be pretend. You can practice how to approach a girl gently.
Rather than just talking about it, I think you'll pick it up better by actually practicing.
Ah, but listen, this is just practice, okay? If you really kiss me, I'll kill you.

File.name: 02-2K-O01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: W... what should I do first?
Let's see... okay. Yeah. Kiss me...
Let's see... try whispering, 'I love you,' or something into my ear.
T-that's no good. I'm pretending to be Katsura-san, so you have to say, 'Kotonoha'.
Well, I mean, it's you who's right here in front of me. It's hard to say, 'Kotonoha'.
Mmm... I guess it can't be helped, then.
You guess? That doesn't sound too reliable.
My chest! Try gently rubbing my chest...
I probably shouldn't touch you, should I?
I... it's okay if it's just through my clothes.
You can do it a little harder...

File.name: 02-2K-O02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I like you, Sekai, but Kotonoha...
Ahaha... well, I thought it was a nice idea. Yeah, just forget about it!

File.name: 02-2K-O03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Oh, come on. What are you all flustered for? I'm joking, of course.
Ah... haha. Really? I seriously thought that...

File.name: 02-2K-O04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay, practice is over. It's the end of lunch. We've got to get back to class.

File.name: 02-2K-O05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Wow... it sure is quiet here on the outskirts of school.
Yeah. There're just a bunch of storerooms here, so people don't come often.
Come to think of it, did you have something to do at lunchtime? You didn't show up, so I ate lunch all by myself... ufufu...

File.name: 02-2K-O06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: 'The rest,' you say... well, that's going to be a problem.
It's a problem for me, too. You can't call it real practice if we've only done half... right?
Let's do the rest... at my house.

File.name: 02-2K-O09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay, I'm going back to class now.

File.name: 02-2K-P00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Looks like our practice didn't teach you a thing.
It's not just Katsura-san. Anyone would panic in a situation like that.
Haah... looks like the practice didn't work out after all.
Yeah... and after you put your body on the line to teach me, too. I really am hopeless.
I'm hating myself more and more...
I can't see Kotonoha like this... I don't even want to get on the train to school tomorrow.
Haah... there's no helping you, is there? You're such a wimp.
You can't give up just because you've failed once or twice.
If you fail today, then just practice some more and try again.
After a lot of training, that is.
If you really want to make it happen, it will happen! For sure!
I see... so it'll happen after all?
Well, that depends on how hard you try.
Uuuh... it feels hopeless after all...
Let's continue at my house... okay?

File.name: 02-2K-Q00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah. This is my 'friend' from class, Itou.
Ahh! Yes, yes, 'Makoto-kun', right? Nice to meet you, Makoto-kun.

File.name: 02-2K-Q01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: But... I didn't think there'd be someone home.
What? You think I'd be like, 'There's no one home today, so...' and drag you back to my house?
I think I kind of messed up at lunchtime. There was no one around the stairs at lunch, so there was kind of a mood going.
It's dangerous to leave a boy and a girl together all alone, you know.
But at my house, we've got my mom in the living room.
If you try anything seriously perverted, I'll shout, okay?
Who's to say? After all, you were this close to kissing me at lunchtime.
Mmn. It's fine, so long as you've realized the error of your ways.
So, to sum up, no seriously perverted stuff. You can go and do that kind of thing with Katsura-san.
Now, with that firmly in mind, let's get to practice.
Ah, but before we start, I'm going to get changed. Go wait outside for a minute.

File.name: 02-2K-Q02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So, I hear that you're her guy.
You're 'Makoto-kun', right? I'm always hearing about you from Sekai.
You're the girl who stood up for Se-chan at the entrance ceremony, aren't you? ...Or were you the boy being picked on?
Ah... yeah, I think something like that happened.
Se-chan and Sekai are always talking about you, so it doesn't really feel like I'm meeting you for the first time.
Come on, Makoto. Let's go back to my room.

File.name: 02-2K-Q03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: My mom is always saying strange things, so don't take her seriously, okay?
This is the first time I've seen you in casual clothes.
You're doing better than at lunchtime... nn...!
Yeah... ah... mmn... you are... mn... nn!
Not even in practice...! Haah... ahh...
It'll just be through clothes... like with your chest...
Then... I guess there's no helping it... hauu... nnn...
I'm... going to take off your bra.
It'll still be through your shirt.
Haah... don't suck so... ah... ah!
No...! This is too embarrassing... nnh... ah...!
No... this is too much... haah... haah...
Don't take it off... you... you can't...
I'm not taking it off... it's still covered.
It's covered... but you're touching... nnaah! Haah... haah!
Yes, but... haah... no... this... this is bad... wrong... mmn!
I want to touch it... your...
You want to...? Haah... haah... phew...
Haah... haah...! That's not fair... mmn...!
Nnn... nnn...! Makoto... I love you!
Haah... ! Ah... ah... no... it's so... your... nnn...!
No... no... I can't... ah...! Ah...!
I came... by myself, didn't I?
Boys just can't help themselves, can they?

File.name: 02-2K-Q04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... I'd like you to use your mouth.
I know that much! It may not look like it, but I'm quite a perverted girl, you know.
No, I'll give it a try.
It might not go well, but... ready?
Hey, does it feel nice when I touch it?
I see... so it feels nice...
Just tell me when you're about to come, okay?
Is it true that boys can't stop themselves when they're about to come?
Then I guess there's no choice in the matter, no matter what you tell me.
I... can't help it... can I? ...Auuu!
S-Sekai... if you keep sucking hard like that, I'll...
You can tell just by looking, right? ...P-please...
Hey... will you listen to whatever I say?
Just kidding! ...Haha... I guess that's more than I can make you say just by holding your dick.
Hold on, I'll take you all the way. Just by looking at your reaction, I've basically figured out how to make it feel good.

File.name: 02-2K-Q05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...When I see you like that... I still want to...
Hmmm.. that makes me kind of happy, and yet it doesn't...
Well, I meant it as a compliment.
It was kind of hard to tell. Well, never mind.
Want me to do it with my mouth one more time...?
I want to... put it inside you...
You can't. Anything but that... nn!
There you go again... it's a lie... and yet, I'm so happy...
It's not a lie. I love you.
I-it's nothing. L-listen... I guess there's no helping it... I don't mind if we do it.
But... you know... it's my first time, so...
...Kuh... Sekai... I'm going to put it in.
I feel a lot calmer now... it's not as painful as I've heard...
Uwah... talk about the worst way to lose your virginity.
What do you mean? That's awful.
But it felt good, so I forgive you.
I did this because I wanted to, you know.
Ah... come to think of it, given how much noise we made, do you think your mom noticed?
She said she's on the late shift tonight, so she should have already left by now.
But if I'd said my mom wasn't going to be home, it'd be as if I was completely seducing you.
Ooh! I really didn't intend for it to end up this way! Believe me!

File.name: 02-2K-R00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's gotten pretty late, hasn't it?
Won't your mom worry about you?
Thankfully, she's on the late shift tonight too.
Well, well... in that case, we could have gone to your house, too.
Yeah, and then maybe it'd be me saying, 'I didn't intend for things to end up this way!'
What is it? The train's about to leave.
The practice ends here. Good night!

File.name: 02-2K-Z00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If you like, you can tell me about it... ah, and if you don't think I can help, I can go and find someone who can!
It's weird... whenever I think about her, I feel like I want to embrace her and...
and even do those perverted things you keep talking about.
Just yesterday, I couldn't help myself. I forced myself on her, and...
But... it's normal to want to do those things with the person you love, right?
You probably just went about it the wrong way.
Anyone would be afraid if you just suddenly threw yourself at them.
I... guess I was a little forceful.
I just don't know how to take a girl's feelings into consideration like that...
You're technically a girl, right? You should know.
'Technically'... that's just mean. Well, I guess you'd normally kiss her...
Listen, why don't you practice on me?
It'll just be pretend. You can practice how to approach a girl gently.
Rather than just talking about it, I think you'll pick it up better by actually practicing.
Ah, but listen, this is just practice, okay? If you really kiss me, I'll kill you.

File.name: 02-2S-A00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Mom, where did you put our thermos?
What's this about, all of a sudden?
Our vacuum bottle. We have one, right?
It's in the back of the cupboard, on the left. What are you going to use it for?
It looks like it's going to be a cold day tomorrow, so I thought I'd bring something warm to drink.
Onee-chan's been acting strange lately, reading books on sewing and digging up books on cooking and stuff.
I see. So, Kotonoha's finally going through that phase.
Kotonoha. What do you intend to make?
I don't know... what about some black tea?
Fufuh... just leave it to me.
I'm going to teach you my recipe for making lemonade. I'm sure your boyfriend is going to love it.
'B-boyfriend'...? I... it's not like that. I just...

File.name: 02-2S-A01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yes, for once, I am. What's with those clothes?
I'm going to change right away. You're coming home early these days, aren't you?
Yes, it's my way of making up for my usual absences. It looks like I'll soon be coming home late again for a while, though.
So... how did it go today?
Come on, don't keep it a secret. Tell me.
That's all right... oh, I know. I'll give you these.
Movie tickets. I got them from a client.
Ah, I'm not giving them to you if you're going to be like that.
But I went to a movie just recently.
Oh, but I'll take them anyway. If it's a different movie, it should be fine.
It looks like it's a remake of an old romance movie.
That should be okay, then. May I have them?

File.name: 02-2S-A02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wonder if Makoto-kun is still awake...?
He's probably asleep. I'll try inviting him tomorrow.

File.name: 02-2S-A03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, Mom. I'm giving you your tickets back.
Giving them back? I've got no use for tickets that expire today, you know.
What, did he turn you down?
N-o, h-e d-i-d-n-'t. Makoto-kun said he had to go and see his sister.
Oh, so his name is Makoto-kun.
That's a shame, but you don't look too down.
I've got to tell Makoto-kun, too.
Be sure to bring this 'Makoto-kun' to our house sometime, okay?
I was just on the phone with your father, and he said he'd like to meet him too.
No way. I don't want to introduce him to Dad.

File.name: 02-2S-B00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You wouldn't tell me anything, so I was worried about you.
It's okay. After all, it looks like you're feeling better now.

File.name: 02-2S-C00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought really hard about it...

File.name: 02-2S-C01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It might make her angry, but I've got to tell her how I really feel.
I'm the one who introduced Katsura-san to you... and just look how things ended up.

File.name: 02-2S-C02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: She's definitely going to get angry.
Yeah, but... I don't think it's right to keep it a secret.

SetSELECT.sel2: 'It's going to be hard to tell her'

File.name: 02-2S-C03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Haah... this is going to be hard.
I'll come and tell her with you.
This would never have happened if I hadn't introduced her to you.

File.name: 02-2S-C04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's going to be hard to tell her.

File.name: 02-2S-C05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: After all, it's about the two of us.
Yep. It's better if we both tell her.

File.name: 02-2S-C06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Yeah. A-after all, you were the one who introduced her to me.
Ah! That's not fair! So it's my fault now?!
Well, not completely, but you're involved in this too...
That doesn't mean I should go by myself... b-besides, I wouldn't know what to say to her.
Y-you know, like, 'The two of us feel the same way'...
Why don't you tell her, then?
After all, this concerns both of us.
Let's tell her together, then. Okay?

File.name: 02-2S-C07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Are we meeting Katsura-san on the roof?

File.name: 02-2S-C08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: If that's the alternative, I'd rather come too.
Okay. Let's tell her together, then.

File.name: 02-2S-C09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "From: Katsura Kotonoha\nSub: I'll be late\nI'm so sorry!"
"I'm so sorry! There's a short-notice student rep meeting today, so I'm going to be about 20 minutes late."
"To: Saionji Sekai\nSub: Fwd: I'll be late\nText: I'm sorry!"

File.name: 02-2S-C10.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay. Hold on for a second.

File.name: 02-2S-G00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You too? I feel the same way.
It's kind of scary, isn't it? After all...
I see Saionji-san's here today too. Ufufu...
Eheheh... you've come on just the right day.
I've brought a little more than usual.
Hot lemonade. It'll warm you up.
It was cold yesterday and the day before, right? That's why I thought it'd be nice to have something warm to drink.
Please have some too, Saionji-san. There's more than enough for everyone.

File.name: 02-2S-H00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't know why, but unlike yesterday and before, Kotonoha seems really cheerful today.

SetSELECT.sel1: 'We don't have to tell her after all'

File.name: 02-2S-H01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...We don't have to tell her after all.
There's no need to tell her something that'll just make her feel bad...
C-crap... is she angry after all...?
Or maybe she's noticed about Sekai?

File.name: 02-2S-H03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura-san's going to be left wondering, you know.

File.name: 02-2S-H04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's warm and sweet... just perfect for this time of year.
Eheheh... I learned the recipe from my mother.
She said it had a memorable taste for her, because she used to make it for Dad when they were dating.

File.name: 02-2S-H05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: We have something to tell you.

File.name: 02-2S-H06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: When are you going to say it?
W-what's she talking about? What do I think about what...?

File.name: 02-2S-H08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Aren't you going to eat any more?
Nope. I'm not really feeling hungry.
Well, I'll be going back to class now.
We've only just begun to eat.
Yep. The two of you can continue.

File.name: 02-2S-I00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah, Saionji-san. If you'd like, you can have some too.
That's okay. I've got my own drink.
Looks like I'm the only one drinking. You have some too, Kotonoha.

File.name: 02-2S-I01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Somehow... you seem really beautiful today!
Uuu... I think I've had too much lemonade... I'm going to the toilet for a second.
Did you... hear that just then?
I can't believe it... did it really happen?
Well... I think you're beautiful, and Makoto probably thinks the same, right?
That's not what I mean. Actually...
I made today's lemonade with a recipe I learned from my mother.
My mother said, 'Once he drinks this, he'll be head over heels for you.'
Ah, you wouldn't really use that expression nowadays, would you...?
But that's not what I mean. I wonder if it really worked, just like Mom said?
I think Makoto saw you in a whole new light.
I think he fell in love with you... all over again.

File.name: 02-2S-I02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...I thought that maybe it was a little too sweet.
Mom said that this would be just right, but this was the first time for me, so...
N-no... oh, I see, you mean the lemonade... u-um...!
It's all right. Next time... I'll be sure to...

File.name: 02-2S-I04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Let's all go back together, then.
It's a little too chilly to be here today, isn't it?

File.name: 02-2S-I06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sure, I'll have a glass too.
Yep! Sweet, with the fragrance of lemons. It's great!
And it's a perfect fit for the weather, too!
Eheheh... I learned the recipe from my mother.
Actually, when I told Mom about Makoto-kun, she said I should bring this lemonade.
I see... your mom told you.
She said, 'I used to bring this on dates with your father, and I used it to make him mine.'
Then it must really work, right?
I thought that might be the case, too.
Hey, what are you two talking about?

File.name: 02-2S-J01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Don't make that face. I couldn't tell her this time, but I'll make sure I do it next time, okay?"
I bet you really like Katsura-san more.
"See that? You just got me in trouble."

File.name: 02-2S-J03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Don't make that face. I couldn't tell her this time, but I'll make sure I do it next time, okay?"

File.name: 02-2S-J08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "The truth is, I don't think I know."

File.name: 02-2S-J09.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "The truth is, I might like Kotonoha."
Ahaha... I think I just had a bad dream...

File.name: 02-2S-K01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I want to talk to you. Have you got a second?

File.name: 02-2S-K02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Okay, then. That's all for today's agenda.

File.name: 02-2S-L00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you so angry about?
If I'm angry, then I'm angry at myself. It's got nothing to do with you.
You're angry about what happened at lunch, right? I'm sorry I couldn't say it. I'll be sure to tell her tomorrow, okay?
You don't have it in you.
And yet, I still can't give up on you, and that makes me angry at myself. It's not your fault. I'm sorry. Goodbye.

File.name: 02-2S-L01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Makoto-kun, were you waiting for me?

File.name: 02-2S-L02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I wanted to speak with Kioura.
Ah! Y-yes, that's right. For your class event, right?
That's okay. I'll be leaving first, then. See you tomorrow.
I have a favor to ask.

File.name: 02-2S-L04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What are you still doing here at this hour?
There's something I want to ask you.
Ah... y-yes, that's right. For your class event, right?
That's all right. I'll be going home first, then. See you later.
Are you friends with that girl from class 4?
You may be right. Since I've got no business with you, then, I'll be going home.
Hey, wait! I said there was something I wanted to ask you.
I-I'm sorry, I shouldn't have put it like that.
What did you want to ask me?

File.name: 02-2S-L05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I finally said it... but maybe I shouldn't have. Maybe Makoto-kun is still keeping it a secret from everyone...
Well, never mind. I feel relieved now... and I'm sure Makoto-kun will forgive me.
Now, to pick up those printouts.

File.name: 02-2S-M00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was going to say it... but when I saw her face, the words just wouldn't come.
We can't tell her, can we?
After all, she's still in love with you...
I'm so in love with you... so why does it feel so bad...?
Was it all because we couldn't say it...?

File.name: 02-2S-M01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What do you mean? It's not fine.
It's not fine... but it's fine.

File.name: 02-2S-M02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: It's fine. You told me that you love me, so I trust you.
You mean about what happened at lunch?
I trust you. I really do... but when I see you and Katsura-san acting so cheerful like that, it worries me.
It's silly, isn't it? You... you've shown me so clearly how you feel, and yet I...
It's strange... I never knew that I was such a jealous person.
I-it's not that I won't... but why now, all of a sudden?
Because I don't want to lose to Katsura-san.
After all, you did it with Katsura-san during lunch.
Both of you drank out of the cup on her thermos.
I know that you don't even notice things like that, but it bothered me.
If you and her are going to share an indirect kiss, then I...
We did it, didn't we? We kissed.

File.name: 02-2S-M03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I love you... even if you love someone else.
I'm sorry... for making you worry.

File.name: 02-2S-N00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I was a little surprised... since I didn't think that you'd be waiting for me.
I really had fun at lunchtime.
Come to think of it, Saionji-san looked a little down today.
Maybe she's got a cold. It's been chilly these last two or three days.
If she's absent tomorrow, perhaps we should go and visit her. After all, there's no student rep meeting...
Ah, yes. There's no student rep meeting tomorrow. If you like, after class, we could...
Eh? I said maybe we could go and visit her...
Um... well, it's not as if I insist on going. If you're free tomorrow too, we could go somewhere and...
You know where Sekai lives, don't you?
I've never been there, but I know the address.
I'm worried about how she looked at lunchtime... please.

File.name: 02-2S-O00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: What's wrong? Were you sleeping? It's almost time for dinner, you know.
I don't want any. I'm not hungry.
That's not why I'm here. You've got a guest.
I don't want to see them.
Tell Setsuna I'm not feeling well. I'll tell her all about it tomorrow.

SetSELECT.sel2: 'You mean more to me than anyone'
'I can't bring myself to hate her'

File.name: 02-2S-P03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I'm such a jealous person... it's so embarrassing...
You told me that you loved me... and yet when I saw you at lunchtime, I felt so worried.

File.name: 02-2S-P04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Maybe I should just forget about you.

File.name: 02-2S-P05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: You mean more to me than anyone.
I love you more than anyone else.
How can I get you to believe me?

File.name: 02-2S-P06.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I don't feel anything for her.
That's a lie. You might like me too, but your feelings for Katsura-san haven't just disappeared.

File.name: 02-2S-P07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I can't bring myself to hate her.
But you're the one I love the most, Sekai.
That much is true, I swear. Believe me.

File.name: 02-2S-R03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai... despite everything, she still loves me.
I decided that I'd be true to my own feelings, too.
And yet, I still can't tell Kotonoha...

SetSELECT.sel2: 'Am I afraid Kotonoha will hate me?'

File.name: 02-2S-R05.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Am I afraid Kotonoha will hate me?
After all, the girl from the morning train is finally smiling my way...

File.name: 02-2S-R07.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I... want you to come with me today too. I'll make sure I...

File.name: 02-2S-R08.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Have you got a minute? I want to talk to you about the school festival.
About how the haunted house is going to work...
What? Do you have something you need to attend to?
Yeah, she's got her lunchbox out. Isn't she just about to go and have lunch somewhere?
Ehhh? You don't want to talk just because you're going to have lunch?
No wonder she doesn't have time to listen to us.
What's the point in asking about her boyfriend?
Yeah, I guess you're right. If he actually wants to go out with Katsura, then...
Katsura. Is that true? Is your boyfriend more important than the class event?
You don't mind, do you? It won't take long.

File.name: 02-2S-S00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: ...There's no point in forcing ourselves to tell her, is there?
I thought we had to tell her together, too... but we can't.
We could tell her if the mood was right, but I don't think we need to force ourselves.
I know how you feel... and I don't want to hurt Katsura-san, either..

File.name: 02-2S-T00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Katsura-san isn't here yet, is she?
Maybe class 4 is a little late.
Hey, you'd better move away soon. It won't be long before...
But if she sees us like this...
We can tell right away from here if the door opens.
Class 4 really have to get their act together, don't they?
The school festival isn't that far away, but they're still making major changes.
But... they don't listen to anything that I say.
And it's not as if we can help either, since we're from the class next door... right, Sekai?
That's all right... I'm just glad I have someone to talk to about it.
I've got a friend in class 4, so maybe I can try talking to her.
She's in the girls' basketball club, but we're from the same junior high school, so it's easy for me to talk to her...
I think she'd hear us out.
How about it? She could help you out.
It's all right. I feel better just telling you about it.
Actually, I wasn't planning on complaining to you like this. Instead...
Um... this weekend, on Saturday or Sunday... are you free?
I know we've been there quite a few times lately... but would you like to see another movie?
My mother gave me some tickets. Here.
Let's see... a romance, huh? Looks like these expire today.
I know it's yet another movie, but since we've got the tickets...

File.name: 02-2S-T01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Ah... sorry. Come to think of it, I can't go today.
I just remembered. My sister's coming over today.
Our parents are divorced, and my little sister Itaru was taken in by my dad.
They come just once a month to see my mom.
It's just Mom who can only see her once a month. I can go and see her any time.
Still, we made a promise that when she comes over, we'd all have dinner together.
I see... well, I guess there's no helping it, then.
Not at all! I had no idea. Please take good care of your sister.

File.name: 02-2S-T02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: They're showing trailers for this movie on TV right now. It's got this nice feel, with a sad piano melody and everything.
Yes, that's right. They say it's a remake of an old movie, but Mom said it was really good.
Your mom's cheering for you and Makoto, isn't she?
Come on, what are you hesitating for? You're free on Saturday, right?
Then it should be fine. There, it's settled.
Oh, no! I've got to get back to class early for homeroom next period! I'll be going on ahead!
Phew... she was sure in a hurry.
Why did you tell me to go on that date?
The one I really love is...
Katsura-san loves you from the bottom of her heart... I can't just walk in and take you away from her.
You've been unsure of yourself since this morning, haven't you?
The truth is, you're still in love with Katsura-san.
That's why... we... we can't be together after all.
"Sorry to be writing an email like this instead of talking to you in person. There's something I have to tell you, but it's just so hard for me to say."
"I'm sorry.\nI'm going to be transferring to another school,"

File.name: 02-2S-T03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Were you talking with Kioura just then about spending the night away from home?
...She said that Katsura-san's busy with the student council, so she's going to be late.
I asked her to send me an e-mail when the meeting finishes.
That way... we won't have to stop, and we'll still know when she's coming.
I see... this way, we can keep going for as long as possible.

File.name: 02-2S-T04.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Fwah...! No... if I take any more off, when Katsura-san comes...
Just a little more... okay...? Nnn!
Ah... haah! ...No... we did it so many times yesterday, so why...? Makoto...!
No matter how many times we do it... it isn't nearly enough... more... I want more of you, Sekai.

File.name: 02-2S-U00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: "Her name's 'Itaru', with the same character as my dad's name. Their name plate ends up looking pretty confusing. She's really small and cute, though!"
"That's so cool. I'm a single child, so I've always wanted a little sister!"
"The last time she came over was the week before last, but this week, not even mom's home, since she's busy with work."
"I didn't know how to turn her down."
"If you see Katsura-san on the weekend, she's going to find out."
"Can I come over to your place?"
"If it's my fault that you have to stay at home, I'll keep you company."
"No one's going to be home today."

File.name: 02-2S-U01.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: And then, you hold out your hand like this and invite them.
What, the girl does the inviting? Are you serious?
Totally serious. If the boy takes your hand, then it means it's okay to confess to him.
But first, you've got to have someone to invite.
What are you talking about? It's not as if you've got someone either.
Oh, come on. You know that none of us do.
Ah, Otome-chan's got someone. It's written all over her face.
No way?! Do you, Otome? Have someone to invite, that is?
W-well, kind of, but... you can still try inviting them even if you know it's hopeless, right?
In that case, I was... kind of thinking of maybe just asking, even though I know I'll just be rejected...
Hey, who is it? Who are you aiming for, Otome?
'Aiming', huh...? Well, he doesn't even talk to me. It really is a hopeless case.
Hey! Give us a hint. We'll try to guess.
...We went to the same junior high school.
Eh?! A boy from our class?
Fwaah! I wonder who it is? Who could it be, Natsumi-chan?
Let's see... there aren't that many boys here from Harami High. Ah, I know. It's that guy from class 3...
Waaah! Don't pry any further! Sheesh!
Katsura's been looking at us all this time.
I wasn't really looking... it's homeroom, so I thought I should join in the conversation...
What are you talking about? We're the only ones who are talking.
Aww, sheesh... after hearing this nonsense from her, I don't feel like doing anything.
You should go and put on that haunted house by yourself. No one's interested in something like that nowadays.
Ehh? I was looking forward to it.
You know, I don't think we can really help you.
We can't possibly work under someone who flashes her eyes at boys all day.
I haven't been flashing my eyes at anyone.
Do you really think no one's looking?
I saw you making a move on Itou from class 3, okay?
I hate to ask this, but would you just keep away from Itou?
If you're willing to work seriously without trying to pick up boys from the class next door, then we'll help.
Itou's from Harami High, isn't he? That means...
I see. So the boy Otome-chan likes is...
Wha-?! That's not what I'm saying at all!
Isn't it? Isn't that the reason why you're lashing out at me?
I'm telling you, that's not it!
I think it's unfair for you to hide behind something like that.
Makoto-kun and I are going out.
We started going out after he confessed to me, so I didn't 'flash my eyes' at him or anything, either.
I understand that you like him, but taking it out on me won't help you.
Please excuse me. I'm going to make some printouts for the student council.

File.name: 02-2S-U02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Sekai, let's go home together. Hikari and the others wanted to meet up at Pure Burger.
Sorry, I've got something to do.
I've got a little favor to ask.

File.name: 02-2S-U03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There aren't enough copies over there. Oh, and send those desks back to the equipment room.
Has the rep from class 4, first year come yet?
She came in, finished up quickly and then left. It looked like she was in a hurry.

File.name: 02-2S-V00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: Hey, Katou. Heading off to club activities?
Itou, are you... no, forget it.
Hmn? Well, see you later, then. Good luck with your club.

File.name: 02-2S-W02.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: So... are things going to be okay at your house?
Don't you have a curfew or something?
It's okay. Officially, I'm staying overnight at Setsuna's house.
We always have sleepovers at each other's houses, so there's no need to get permission from my mom or hers.
I can stay for the night.

File.name: 02-2S-W03.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: I thought a boy's room would be messier.
Well, it's probably a little cleaner than usual.
I'll bet you've hidden all your porn, too.
...This is just like back then, isn't it?
On the roof, that day when we first started sitting next to each other.
No... that we'd be sitting next to each other.
I've had my eyes on you since the entrance ceremony, you know.
But we never had much chance to speak, and I started to like you more and more as I watched you,
so it became even harder for me to talk to you...
And yet, when I ended up sitting next to you, you were doing that charm with another girl's photo.
I know. But thanks to that, we got to become friends.
Was that a little too hard?
It's just that... this is kind of embarrassing.
You can... touch me however you like.
Even through your panties... I can see it so clearly...
I'm going to pull it off... okay?
Just by thinking about how you're touching me, I...
I'm going to take it off...
Your nipples... they've gotten so hard.
When your lips just brush them... it feels like an electric shock...
I'm going to take it all off, okay...?
I'm going to take it off, so...
You were... so beautiful... and so... sexy.
It's... my first time too, so...
You... looked like you really wanted to do it with Katsura-san, so...
I thought... you'd be experienced with stuff like this...
Eheheh... that makes two of us, then.
If it's the first time for both of us... it's not so scary.
If it's with you... it's not scary at all. Let's do it together... for the first time.
I'm... going to put it in.
You're going to put that... inside me... aren't you?
Are you getting scared after all?
Ah! But... I guess... I don't know if you could call it 'scared'...
I might be a little... embarrassed...
Will you... turn off the lights?
Uh-huh! It... just hurts... a little...
If you do... I'll be okay...
This might... feel kind of... good!
Good... ah... it feels so... good!
Eheheh... you spurted a lot... didn't you?
It's okay... I can feel it... so hot, inside my body... it makes me feel really happy, you know?
We really... had sex, didn't we?
Even though... you're still Katsura-san's boyfriend...
What are you talking about...? You're the one that I love.
But... you're still Katsura-san's boyfriend... you haven't broken up with her...
After all... I know that you love me!
What's wrong? Why the sudden laughter?
Somehow, now that I've calmed down, it's all finally starting to feel real.
I did it with Makoto... my first time, with the person that I love. That's incredible, isn't it?
I was so happy... so happy that the happiness just completely filled my chest... and I thought, 'Ahh... so this is what it means to be happy.'
That makes two of us, right?

File.name: 02-2S-X00.ENG.ORS
File.PrintText: There you go, yawning again. You were the one who suggested we leave at this hour.
Nnn... yeah, but I can't help being sleepy.
You've never been to school this early, have you?
I guess this is what they call 'the trip home on the morning after', huh.
Yeah, but we're headed for school instead.
Maybe we should say something to Kioura, too.
Wah! N-no! Don't worry, I'll tell her myself.
We wouldn't want her to misunderstand.
She already suspects that we're going out.
We'll be in trouble if we don't treat it as one.
If we don't, Katsura-san is going to...
